description: What a sleep study is scored into: the stage of each epoch and the events read from the polygraphic channels. It extends HED-SCORE rather than competing with it. HED-SCORE stays the finding vocabulary of a clinical EEG reading, and a sleep scorer needs terms it does not have, an apnea by its mechanism or a desaturation, and a closed set a file can be translated into. A term takes the HED-SCORE tag as its name where SCORE has one, spelled the way SCORE spells its tags, and carries that tag as its `hed` crosswalk, so a coded study reads across to a SCORE report; a term SCORE lacks is named in the same style and carries no crosswalk. Every category is scoped `scoring`: these are readings of the signal, kept apart from the acquisition sets, which hold what the signal cannot recover. Sleep stages are stored as coded events rather than free-text labels because a code's value is served under a de-identifying grant and a name is not.

SLEEP_STAGE.description: The stage of a scoring epoch. An event covers the epochs it spans, so a scorer's run of one stage and a file's single long stage annotation read the same way.

W.name: Sleep-stage-W
W.description: Wakefulness. SCORE stages sleep and has no term for an awake epoch.

N3.name: Sleep-stage-N3
N3.description: Non-REM stage 3, slow-wave sleep. Stages 3 and 4 of the older Rechtschaffen and Kales rules both map here.

UNSCORED.name: Sleep-stage-unscored
UNSCORED.description: An epoch that was not or could not be scored, such as one obscured by movement. It counts as neither sleep nor wake.

AROUSAL.name: Sleep-related-arousal
AROUSAL.description: An abrupt shift in EEG frequency during sleep.

RESPIRATORY.description: Respiratory events read from the airflow, effort and oximetry channels. SCORE has one apnea term; the mechanism is what a sleep report turns on, so each carries that term as its crosswalk and keeps the mechanism here.

APNEA_OBSTRUCTIVE.name: Apnea-obstructive
APNEA_OBSTRUCTIVE.description: Cessation of airflow with continued respiratory effort.

APNEA_CENTRAL.name: Apnea-central
APNEA_CENTRAL.description: Cessation of airflow without respiratory effort.

APNEA_MIXED.name: Apnea-mixed
APNEA_MIXED.description: An apnea beginning without respiratory effort and ending with it.

HYPOPNEA.name: Hypopnea
HYPOPNEA.description: A reduction in airflow short of an apnea.

RERA.name: Respiratory-effort-related-arousal
RERA.description: Increased respiratory effort ending in an arousal, without the airflow reduction of a hypopnea.

LIMB_MOVEMENT.description: Limb movements read from the leg EMG channels.

PERIODIC.name: Sleep-periodic-limb-movement
PERIODIC.description: A limb movement belonging to a periodic series.
